name: idc-cddp-eagle-1
description: DICOM converted whole slide images of H&E-stained frozen sections of primary lung adenocarcinoma tumor tissue from 49 subjects in the Environment And Genetics in Lung cancer Etiology (EAGLE) study, a population-based case-control study conducted in the Lombardy region of Italy (2002-2005). The original Aperio SVS slide images were obtained from the GDC and converted to DICOM Slide Microscopy format. Please see the CDDP-EAGLE-1 Zenodo page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
